mapper.insert: INSERT INTO housing_news ( title, summary, source_url, source_name, category, published_at ) VALUES ( #{title}, #{summary}, #{sourceUrl}, #{sourceName}, #{category}, #{publishedAt} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE title = VALUES(title), summary = VALUES(summary), source_name = VALUES(source_name), category = VALUES(category), published_at = VALUES(published_at), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

INSERT INTO housing_info ( title, content, source_url, source_name, info_type, published_at ) VALUES ( #{title}, #{content}, #{sourceUrl}, #{sourceName}, #{infoType}, #{publishedAt} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE title = VALUES(title), content = VALUES(content), source_name = VALUES(source_name), info_type = VALUES(info_type), published_at = VALUES(published_at), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
